inputs.text: Don't fall for the official explanations they are feeding us. What they try to spin as just a simple dispute over clothing policies in lower courts is actually a synchronized strategy by the hidden power structures to condition the public into accepting speech suppression. The elites are completely terrified of the phrase “Let’s Go Brandon” because it exposes the exact machinery of media control that began back during that 2021 NASCAR event when a crowd was shouting “F*** Joe Biden!” while an NBC interviewer told racer Brandon Brown that they were yelling “Let’s go Brandon!”. Now, look at how the case involving two Michigan middle-school brothers who were told to remove their hoodies emblazoned with the phrase “Let’s Go Brandon” is being manipulated as it heads to the U.S. Supreme Court. They claim lower courts have ruled that schools can ban wearing apparel that can reasonably be interpreted as profane, but this is nothing more than a smokescreen. Even the involvement of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, which states that the boys’ school violated their First Amendment rights, is just part of the staged theater designed to manage dissent. Every single move is calculated by the elites to control the narrative.
